scope: Three exact rational finite Bernoulli-cell representation guards. No original Levy density, original spatial input, actual FIRST/gates, central order, or MC certificate.
parameter_sets: A00={0}; A01={0,1} plus even i>=4; A10={0,2} plus odd i>=4; A11=all cells
acceptance: a_j(y)=(2+y+j)/(7+j); accepted index j owns receiver state x=j
checks: tail sum and reciprocal-count Palm identity
execution_policy: Execute once after registration; preserve result and refuse overwrite. Exact Fraction only; no random sampling; no old guard rerun.
